possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-generation instruct model whose card says it 'may still occasionally produce inaccurate, biased, or unsafe responses' and whose training includes synthetic data, so factually inaccurate/untruthful outputs are a plausible risk.

possible_risks.description: Historical and societal biases might be present in data that are used to train and fine-tune models. Biases can also be inherited from seed data or exacerbated by synthetic data generation methods.
possible_risks.justification: card explicitly says the model 'may still occasionally produce ... biased ... responses' and training includes open-source instruction data and synthetic data, which can carry historical/societal biases.

possible_risks.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.
possible_risks.justification: card explicitly says it 'may still occasionally produce ... unsafe responses' for an open-weight text-generation model, so language that could lead to physical harm is plausible.

possible_risks.description: Toxic output occurs when the model produces hateful, abusive, and profane (HAP) or obscene content. This also includes behaviors like bullying.
possible_risks.justification: card explicitly says it 'may still occasionally produce ... unsafe responses' and the model is an open-weight chat/instruct model, so hateful, abusive, or profane output is plausible.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: card describes training data only at a high level ('permissively licensed open-source instruction datasets, internally collected synthetic data, and a small amount of human-curated data') without dataset details or synthetic-data generation documentation.

specifications.model_size: 6.3 GiB of safetensors weights (6,748,626,432 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: Post-training included supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based alignment, and model merging, with a structured chat format.
training_context.training_data: The model is a fine-tune of Granite-3.0-3B-A800M-Base-4K, trained on permissively licensed open-source instruction datasets, internally collected synthetic data, and a small amount of human-curated data.
